jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Platform
jobs.content: <p>Northwind AI builds AI copilots for logistics companies. We are a remote-first team of 60.</p><p>You will design, ship and operate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems used by thousands of dispatchers.</p><p>What you&#x27;ll do:</p><li>Build LLM applications in Python with structured outputs and retrieval over our document store.</li><li>Own evaluation: build gold sets, LLM-as-judge rubrics and regression suites that run in CI/CD.</li><li>Deploy services with FastAPI and Docker on GCP (Cloud Run, Vertex AI, BigQuery).</li><li>Monitor quality, latency and token cost in production, and decide what ships.</li><p>What we&#x27;re looking for:</p><li>5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with LLM applications in production.</li><li>Strong Python and SQL; experience with prompt engineering and embeddings.</li><li>Experience with Terraform is a plus.</li><p>This role is fully remote for candidates based in LATAM, as an independent contractor paid in USD.</p>
